sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_search" USING fts5(memory_id UNINDEXED, title, note, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "locations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "city" TEXT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "gallery_asset_id" TEXT NULL, "local_preview_path" TEXT NULL, "cloud_object_key" TEXT NULL, "original_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "mime_type" TEXT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "last_verified_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "title" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "location_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "cover_media_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id), "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "source_journal_entry_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER memory_search_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON memories BEGIN INSERT INTO memory_search (memory_id, title, note) VALUES (new.id, COALESCE(new.title, ''), COALESCE(new.note, ''));END

CREATE TRIGGER memory_search_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON memories BEGIN DELETE FROM memory_search WHERE memory_id = old.id;INSERT INTO memory_search (memory_id, title, note) SELECT new.id, COALESCE(new.title, ''), COALESCE(new.note, '') WHERE new.deleted_at IS NULL;END
CREATE TRIGGER memory_search_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON memories BEGIN DELETE FROM memory_search WHERE memory_id = old.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "people" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'human', "relation_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "birth_date" TEXT NULL, "avatar_media_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_people" ("memory_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("memory_id", "person_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "cover_media_id" TEXT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private', "start_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_collections" ("memory_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("memory_id", "collection_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rituals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'yearly', "related_person_id" TEXT NULL, "anchor_month" INTEGER NULL, "anchor_day" INTEGER NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ritual', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_rituals" ("memory_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ritual_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rituals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_year" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("memory_id", "ritual_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_media" ("memory_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "media_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("memory_id", "media_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_memories_category ON memories (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_memories_occurred_at ON memories (occurred_at, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_memories_on_this_day ON memories (occurred_month, occurred_day)
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_people_person ON memory_people (person_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_collections_collection ON memory_collections (collection_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_rituals_ritual ON memory_rituals (ritual_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_media_media ON memory_media (media_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "entry_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "title" TEXT NULL, "mood_score" INTEGER NULL, "prompt_id" TEXT NULL, "mood_key" TEXT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "privacy_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard', "converted_memory_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_media" ("journal_entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "media_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("journal_entry_id", "media_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_journal_media_media ON journal_media (media_id)
